chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Al-Amari ibn Ali, from Ali ibn Ja'far, from his brother Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him), said:
I asked him about a woman who gave birth from adultery, is it permissible to breastfeed by her milk? He said: It is not permissible, nor the milk of her daughter who was born from the adultery.
ai.seo_question: Is the milk of a woman who gave birth from adultery permissible for breastfeeding?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) clarifies the legal status of milk from a woman who gave birth via adultery, ruling it unsuitable for breastfeeding. This ruling extends to the milk of her daughter born from the same illicit union, highlighting the significance of lineage purity in Shia jurisprudence. The narration underscores how the mode of conception affects the ritual and legal validity of the milk, a key consideration in *radāʿ* (breastfeeding) laws.
